verdict.rationale: AvaTax has a REST API and multi-language SDKs to record transactions (CreateTransaction) from any source, and explicitly touts applying consistent tax logic across ecommerce, marketplace, POS, and ERP systems, implying multi-channel ingestion. However, evidence does not show pre-built connectors/plugins for specific storefronts or processors (e.g., Shopify, Stripe) or documented bulk backfill/import tooling beyond single-transaction API calls. missing for 10: documented prebuilt connectors for named storefronts/processors, bulk historical backfill/import endpoints or ETL tooling, and independent confirmation of multi-source aggregation working in practice.
